body: The affected-selection lane (2026-10-21) skipped V1-2075. Narrowing rule (d) for AGENTS.md changes is unsound unless the plan carries why a witness was selected, and no wire field holds that reason today. This ticket asks for that field, so V1-2075 can then narrow soundly.
title: affected: narrowing rule (d) for AGENTS.md needs a witness-reason wire field (V1-2075 blocker)
